owner_request_2026_11_16_third.statement_summary: the app still needs a lot of performance work; create a performance mode where effects stay visible and invisible or barely visible things are reduced, to raise performance and lower latency and loading; fix the like animation moving the button and title; a new video mode for shared lyrics with the Canvas blurred behind and synchronised lyrics in the middle, up to four lines (a screenshot of another app's share sheet given as inspiration, not to copy).

done.performance_mode: highPerformanceMode now renders glass as Blur (it used to switch glass to Static, i.e. no glass effect), removes per-line lyric blur layers, runs ArtworkFlow every fourth frame instead of stopping it, disables Coil crossfades (read at image-loader creation), and no longer turns off album hero Canvas; living artwork and lyric breathing stay off in it
done.like: HeartBurst measured 96 dp inside the heart's Box, so the first like grew the title row; it is now laid out as a zero-size point at the button's centre
done.lyrics_video: LyricVideo: 720x1280, 30 fps, H.264 baseline via MediaCodec input surface (lockHardwareCanvas), muxed to MP4 with frame-count timestamps, no audio; window from 0.7 s before the first line to 1.3 s after the next line's start (15 s max); Canvas frames read every 100 ms at 54x96 and cross-faded, else three rotating blurred cover copies; frosted card with up to four lines, word fill from word times, cover thumbnail, title, artist, optional KETVOICE mark; shared as video/mp4 with the title link. MomentCard MAX_LINES 2 -> 4
